capabilities: Maintain a glossary index file of linkable terms
Wrap matching index terms in the active note with wikilinks
Suggest index terms from existing vault note titles
Exclude unwanted terms from future suggestions
disambiguation: Not a link index or backlink manager; it builds a glossary and inserts wikilinks into note text.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Manually spotting and wrapping recurring terms in [[wikilinks]] across notes is slow, and Obsidian offers no automatic term-to-link matching.
summary: Glossary-based auto-linker that maintains a term index file and wraps matching words in notes with wiki-style links.
